simple.meaning: מוּק (mûwq) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to jeer , i.e. (intens.) blaspheme.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Psalms, beginning at Psalms 73:8. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוּק (H4167) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: מוּק (mûwq) / H4167 is traced through Psalms 73:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H4167. muq [ מִיק מוּק, ] verb mock, deride (Aramaic Pa`el מַיֵּיק , , and Aph`el אָמֵיק ); — Imperfect 3masculine plural (probably Hiph`il) יָמִ֫יקוּ Psa 73:8 (|| בְּרָע וִידַבְּרוּ ). מוֺקְדָה מוֺקֵד, see יקד . מוֺקֵשׁ see יקשׁ .
